rationale: KAD-PI exposes only models that carry no marginal per-token cost: inference it owns locally, subscriptions the operator already pays for, and free-tier ids. Metered providers are projected only through their explicitly free-tier ids, so no harness fallback chain can turn into an unapproved bill. This is the enforcement point for REQ-KAD-FIN-001 (unauthorized metered spend FORBIDDEN).
operator_notes: `include_all_from` is the local + subscription lane: local KAD GGUF endpoints (llama-cpp) and the operator's already-paid subscriptions (OpenCode Go, Google AI Pro via agy/antigravity).
`metered` providers contribute only ids carrying a free-tier marker.

`exclude_prefixes` drops the gateway's own auto/* routing combos, which would otherwise select across every upstream the gateway knows about, including metered ones. auto/*:free survives via the free-tier marker and is safe because :free cannot fall back to a paid candidate.
`unlisted_providers: exclude` means a provider nobody has classified is never exposed. Adding a connection therefore never widens model exposure on its own: it must also be listed here.
Local models appear in the catalog only while the KAD KoboldCpp endpoints are running (bin/kad-serve). When they are offline the gateway cannot enumerate them, and they drop out of the exposed set.
